decision.top3_why: The weighted strategy (full pool, weights from a gradient‑boosted meta‑model) achieves the lowest validation score (0.7075) and shows the most stable per‑window performance (0.6909, 0.6983, 0.7086). decision.top3_why_not: The plain mean (A) has a slightly higher score (0.7091) and exhibits larger variation across windows (0.6909, 0.7636, 0.6727), indicating sensitivity to ranking shifts.
